verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a media toolkit could plausibly offer AI-driven analysis or suggestions about media. The evidence shows no such capability, though. The community mentions Whisper being added to FFmpeg for transcription, which is adjacent AI processing rather than insights or suggestions. Users relying on external LLMs to generate commands is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
